verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets users delegate content-generation tasks to its built-in assistant (chat Q&A, auto-generated summaries, audio/video overviews, study guides, slide decks, mind maps, quizzes) and the probe notes a 'Deep Research' mode that autonomously gathers web sources into the notebook, showing some task-delegation beyond simple chat. However, this falls short of true agentic delegation—community feedback confirms it could not autonomously search for and incorporate documents (only ingesting user-provided sources) and interactive/agentic follow-up (e.g., interacting with generated podcasts) was described as janky, indicating the assistant is mostly generative/summarizing rather than an autonomous task-executing agent. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-step autonomous task execution, ability to act outside the notebook (e.g., fetch/search independently at scale), and confirmation that Deep Research fully resolves the community-reported search limitation.
